ablations_not_run_reason: A deal-level ablation between two PIMC agents puts search on all four seats, so at eight worlds it runs about three minutes per deal. The four planned contrasts projected to roughly four more hours and were abandoned on cost grounds rather than run at a size that would invite over-reading.

action_stability.note: Prefix nesting is exact, so a change between budgets is a genuine change of opinion rather than a different sample.

computational_practicality: 128 pairs was not computationally practical: at 0.050 deals per second with PIMC on two seats, one pair costs roughly 20 worker-minutes, so 128 pairs is about 7 hours at six workers. The 32-pair design took 5.5 hours and resolved the effect because the effect is large.

headline: The uniform-feasible PIMC baseline loses decisively to development_reference_v1 over complete matches: p_win 0.156, 0 wins / 10 ties / 22 losses over 32 pairs, sign-flip p = 0.0001. Zero legs censored and zero decisions failed, so this is a strength result rather than a harness defect.

interpretation: Selection optimism from small samples was tested and refuted: the RAMI declaration rate rises with the world budget rather than falling. What survives is policy mismatch - PIMC values an action assuming reference play by its own partner while both its seats actually play PIMC - and root strategy fusion, which observation-only rollouts weaken but do not remove.

bank.name: phase5c_match_comparison_v1
bank.purpose: Phase 5C complete-match development comparison for the PIMC baseline. A development bank; the promotion-sealed bank stays unopened.

primary_complete_match_comparison.hypothesis: Does uniform_feasible_pimc_small_v1 beat partner_aware_v1 over complete matches from 0-0?
primary_complete_match_comparison.name: phase5c_uniform_feasible_pimc_small_v1_vs_partner_aware_v1
primary_complete_match_comparison.sign_convention: The candidate is the PIMC agent, so p_win above 0.5 means PIMC beats the opponent over complete matches.
primary_complete_match_comparison.worker_independence: Every pair is a pure function of the bank, comparison, safety cap, and ordinal, so the worker count changes wall-clock time only.

promotion_status: No Phase 5C result is promotion evidence. Every bank used is a development bank and the promotion-sealed bank was never opened.

showing_contract_sensitivity.hypothesis: Selection optimism: the chosen action is the argmax of a few noisy per-world means, which flatters the higher-variance contract. If that is the mechanism, the RAMI declaration rate falls as the world count rises and approaches the reference agent's rate.

utility_ablation_is_uninformative_from_z: From 0-0 the two registerable adapters are exactly ordinally equivalent - the winner's rise equals the deal points - so a showing census at that score cannot separate them. Verified exhaustively with zero ordering disagreements.
